pers_11_share.label: 11 personnel (3 WR)
pers_11_share.help: Share of offensive snaps with 1 back, 1 tight end and 3 receivers.

pers_12_share.label: 12 personnel (2 TE)
pers_12_share.help: Share of offensive snaps with 1 back, 2 tight ends and 2 receivers.

pers_heavy_share.label: Heavy sets
pers_heavy_share.help: Share of snaps with two or more tight ends or two or more backs.

shotgun_share.label: Shotgun
shotgun_share.help: Share of offensive snaps taken from shotgun or pistol.

time_to_throw.label: Time to throw
time_to_throw.help: Average seconds from snap to throw on charted dropbacks. Mixes the QB, the protection and the play design.

pressure_allowed_rate.label: Pressure allowed
pressure_allowed_rate.help: Share of charted dropbacks where the QB was pressured.

epa_vs_man.label: EPA/dropback vs man
epa_vs_man.noun: EPA per dropback against man coverage
epa_vs_man.help: Expected points added per dropback against man coverage (2018+ charting).

epa_vs_zone.label: EPA/dropback vs zone
epa_vs_zone.noun: EPA per dropback against zone coverage
epa_vs_zone.help: Expected points added per dropback against zone coverage (2018+ charting).

epa_vs_pressure.label: EPA/dropback under pressure
epa_vs_pressure.help: Expected points added per dropback when the QB was pressured.

man_rate.label: Man coverage
man_rate.help: Share of charted dropbacks defended in man coverage (2018+). Compare within a season only: the charting provider changed in 2023.

two_high_rate.label: Two-high shells
two_high_rate.help: Share of charted dropbacks with two safeties deep at the snap (2018+).

blitz_rate.label: Five-plus rushers
blitz_rate.help: Share of dropbacks with five or more pass rushers.

pressure_rate.label: Pressure rate
pressure_rate.help: Share of charted dropbacks where the defense pressured the QB.

epa_allowed_vs_11.label: EPA allowed vs 11 personnel
epa_allowed_vs_11.help: Expected points per play allowed against three-receiver sets.

epa_allowed_vs_heavy.label: EPA allowed vs heavy sets
epa_allowed_vs_heavy.help: Expected points per play allowed against 2+ tight end or 2+ back sets.

epa_allowed_man.label: EPA allowed in man
epa_allowed_man.help: Expected points per dropback allowed when in man coverage.

epa_allowed_zone.label: EPA allowed in zone
epa_allowed_zone.help: Expected points per dropback allowed when in zone coverage.

note: Percentiles are within-season vs the league. Coverage data starts 2018; the charting provider changed in 2023, so man and two-high rates shift league-wide.
